prompts.prompt: In SQL Server 2025, what is the maximum RAM supported by Standard Edition. Answer with the exact number and unit.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/sql-server/references/versions/2025.md - Standard Edition Improvements section: RAM limit raised to 256 GB, up from 128 GB.

prompts.prompt: In SQL Server 2025, is optimized locking turned on by default for a database. Answer with yes or no.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/sql-server/references/versions/2025.md - Optimized Locking section note: Optimized locking is disabled by default in SQL Server 2025 and requires Accelerated Database Recovery to be enabled first.

prompts.prompt: What is the maximum number of nonclustered indexes allowed on a single SQL Server table. Answer with the exact number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/sql-server/SKILL.md - Indexing Strategies table: Nonclustered index row notes a maximum of 999 nonclustered indexes.
